brief:
Former Israeli military chief Gadi Eisenkot, a prime ministerial candidate, denounced what he called Netanyahu's "racist" campaign targeting Palestinian citizens of Israel, Al Jazeera English reported. Eisenkot characterized attempts to marginalize and discredit Palestinian Israelis as "an anti-state act," positioning the issue as a matter of Israeli state integrity rather than sectarian politics.

The criticism reflects deepening tensions within Israeli politics over the treatment of the country's Palestinian minority. Eisenkot's comments suggest growing division among Israeli political figures on the tactics being deployed against Palestinian citizens ahead of elections.
dek: Prime ministerial hopeful calls attempts to marginalise and smear Palestinian citizens of Israel 'an anti-state act'.
title: Eisenkot accuses Netanyahu of racist campaign against Palestinian Israelis
